desc: A TRUE MOUNTAIN RIFLE must be light and accurate – hardcore hunters understand. Adirondack models are the lightest production big game rifles ever offered, delivering legendary Kimber accuracy yet still weighing as little as 4 pounds, 13 ounces. Reinforced carbon fiber stocks add strength and stainless steel shrugs the elements. Adirondack models feature a spiral fluted bolt body and hollow bolt knob, making it compact and fast. These rifles have no equal.
